Name: Clone app
Description: Changes the app package name to allow installing the same app multiple times. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name. Each cloned install must use a unique package name. Cloning does not work with all apps and using this patch may cause app crashes or other unexpected behavior.
Enabled: false

Index: 1
Name: Change installer source
Description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.
Enabled: false

Index: 2
Name: Override certificate pinning
Description: Overrides certificate pinning, allowing to inspect traffic via a proxy.
Enabled: false

Index: 3
Name: Spoof signature
Description: Spoofs the package signature of the original APK.
Enabled: false

Index: 4
Name: Disable Play Store updates
Description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting
Enabled: false

Index: 5
Name: Hide ads
Description: Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.
Enabled: true
Compatible packages:
	Package name: com.google.android.apps.youtube.music
	Compatible versions:
		9.20.53
		9.15.51
